title: Configuring the NX-400 Edge Router for Fixed-Wireless Sites

headings.text: Configuring the NX-400 Edge Router for Fixed-Wireless Sites

key_sentences: This guide describes how to install and configure an NX-400 edge router at a fixed-wireless base station.
It covers the initial configuration, the VLAN plan, monitoring and the checks to complete before a site is handed over to operations.
Never climb the tower or open the cabinet without a second person present.
Connect to the console port at 115200 baud and log in with the factory account.
The dry run must finish without errors before the commit is attempted.
The router exports its metrics to the regional collector every 60 seconds.
If a fault cannot be cleared within two hours, roll back to the previous configuration and escalate to the on-call engineer.

rows: NX-400 hardware revision 2 and later, firmware 7.4.x
Subscriber traffic to the aggregation ring
One VLAN per sector radio Never bridge two sectors
Radio not powered, or PoE budget too low
Check the injector LED and set the PoE budget to 30 W per port
MTU mismatch with the far end
Set the MTU to 9100 on both ends and reload the interface
Ping the collector from the router and raise a ticket with the NOC

list_items.text: A laptop with an SSH client and the site configuration file from the provisioning portal.
The site’s management IP address, gateway and VLAN identifiers.
A console cable (RJ45 to USB-C) and a spare SFP+ module.
A change ticket in the Approved state.
Step 1 Confirm that all three sector ports are up and passing traffic.
Step 2 Run a 15-minute throughput test across the backhaul and record the result in the ticket.
Step 3 Check that the router appears on the monitoring dashboard with no active alarms.
Step 4 Photograph the cabinet, the cable labels and the earth bonding.
Step 5 Hand the site over to the Network Operations Centre by phone and close the ticket.

furniture: Kestrel Valley Telecom · Field Deployment Guide KVT-DG-112 · Revision C
code:
scp KV-0417-base.yaml admin@192.0.2.1:/config/
ssh admin@192.0.2.1
nxcli config load /config/KV-0417-base.yaml --dry-run
nxcli config load /config/KV-0417-base.yaml --commit --comment "KVT-CHG-30218"

site:
  id: KV-0417
  name: "Harrow Ridge"
  timezone: Europe/London
management:
  vlan: 999
  address: 10.41.7.2/29
  gateway: 10.41.7.1
uplink:
  interface: xe-0/1/0
  vlans: [100, 300]
  mtu: 9100
sectors:
  - { port: ge-0/0/0, vlan: 210, azimuth: 0 }
  - { port: ge-0/0/1, vlan: 211, azimuth: 120 }
  - { port: ge-0/0/2, vlan: 212, azimuth: 240 }

[telemetry]
collector = 10.0.88.20:4317
interval_s = 60
export = interfaces, optics, cpu, temperature

[alarms]
optics_rx_low_dbm = -18.0
temperature_high_c = 70
